extra.en: 英语六级作文模板 一、针对一个话题 这个模板的中文大意是：在某种场合，发生某种现象，并提供一些相关数据，然后列出 这种现象的三个原因，并将三个原因总结为一个最主要原因，最后提出避免这种现象的两个 办法。总的来说，利用这个模板写英语作文，是相当容易的，您只要将适当的内容，填写到 对应的方括号中，一篇通顺的英语作文即可完成。下面就是这个模板。 Nowadays, there are more and more [某种现象] in [某种场合]. It is estimated that [相关 数据]. Why have there been so many [某种现象]? Maybe the reasons can be listed as follows. The first one is [原因一]. Besides, [原因二]. The third one is [原因三]. To sum up, the main cause of [某种现象] is due to [最主要原因]. It is high time that something were done upon it. For one thing, [解决办法一]. On the other hand, [解决办法二]. All these measures will certainly reduce the number of [某种现象]. (I)说明原因型 模块(一) Nowadays, there are more and more XX in some big cities . It is estimated that ( 1 ). Why have there been so many XX ? Maybe the reasons can be listed as follows. The first one is that ( 2 ).Besides, ( 3 ). The third reason is ( 4 ). To sum up, the main cause of XX is due to ( 5 ) . Why have there been so much misunderstanding between parents and children? Maybe the reasons can be listed as follows. There exist varying/ a variety of points concerning it. 你对...有什么看法，关于这个事情存在不同的观点。 4 There is no doubt that the issue about sth has caused wide public attention recently. 毫无疑问的是关于...的事件，已经引起公众的关注。 其他表达形式，可选择一句自己喜欢的做模板 In my opinion/for my part/ from my perspective/ it keeps my perspective that..... (在我看来/就我而言/从我的角度来看/它保持了我的观点.....) 第二段：分析原因段（分析原因总起句+2-3 个原因） 第一句：分析原因总起句 There stand at least three reasons, from my perspective, for the present phenomenon. 在我看来，目前的现象至少有三个原因。 后几句举例子：2-3 个原因 The main factor is that...;Then more importantly,...; what’s more,..... 首先.,其次..,最重要的是... 引出原因的总起句还可使用以下其一句子 1 The majority of people would agree that 主题has its deep roots. 大多数人会同意，..有其深厚的根源。 2 It is superficially a simple phenomenon, but when subjected to analysis, it has its fundamental reasons. 这表面上是一种简单的现象，但当接受分析时，它有其根本原因。 3 As we know, recognizing a problem is the first step in finding a solution. 正如我们所知，识别问题是找到解决方案的第一步。 4 There exist numerous elements being responsible for the issue 存在许多因素对这个问题负责。 5 The reason for this is not far to seek. 原因并不遥远。 6 It is quite a few factors that can account for my perspective. 有相当多的因素可以解释我的观点 第三段：总结措施段（总结句+1-2 句措施+喊口号（措施有2 句的话，口号可不写）） 第一句:总结句 In short, it is a sound conclusion that can be drawn that... 总之,我们可以得出结论..... 第二句：措施句（我们/政府/家长/学校） 举例:Students, from their early age, could be educated to learn the advantages and disadvantages of living in big cities. 学生们在很小的时候就应该被教育了解生活在大城市的利弊. 结尾句(喊口号）推荐 总结句可三选一。 1 As a result,just as a coin has two sides,主题词is no exception.(正反两面的作文） 因此，就像硬币有两面一样，.......也不例外 2 From what has been mentioned above,we can safely draw the conclusion that..... 通过以上所述，我们可以得出结论..... 3 It is important for us to keep an eye on the subject. 对我们来说，关注这个问题是非常重要的 1 So under no account could 人divert attention from the issue of sth. 因此，无论如何人们都不能把注意力从……问题上转移开。 2 Only by taking these action can people have a more brilliant and glorious future. 只有采取这些行动，人们才能有一个更加灿烂辉煌的未来。 3 The more quickly measures are taken,the more effectively this problem will be solved . 采取的措施越快，这个问题就越能得到有效解决。 称呼 文中给出：Dear+称呼 文中未给出：Dear sir or Madam 正文： 第一段：对于不熟悉的人：自我介绍+写作目的(2 句话） 自我介绍： I am a freshman from the department of +你的专业in this university. 译文：我是这所大学...专业大一的学生 写作目的: The aim of my letter is to +目的 译文：我这封信的目的是..... 对于熟悉的人：问候+写作目的（2 句话） How are you getting on with you life and work/study? The aim of my letter is to +目的 你的生活和工作/学习近来如何？我写这封信的目的是..... 第二段：根据文章要求写 第三段：表示感谢/祝福语+期待回信 At last, thank you for your consideration of my suggestion. I am looking forward to your reply. Yours truly, LiMing 表示感谢 Words fail me when I desire to express my sincere gratitude to you for your kind consideration my requirement/application/complaint 对于您对我的要求/申请/投诉的认真考虑，我无法用语言表达我诚挚的谢意 期待回信： I look forward to a favorable reply at your earliest convenience. 我期待着你能尽快给我一个有利的答复。 刘晓艳四级作文模板（书信作文） 例文： Directions: Suppose you are writing a proposal to your school library about improving it's services, you are writing about its current problems and solutions. 假设你正在写一份关于改善学校图书馆服务的建议，你要写的是它目前存在的问题和 解决方案。 Dear Sir or Madam, I am a junior from the department of Fine Arts in this university. I'm writing to make a proposal about improving the service of our library. 译文：尊敬的先生或女士，我是这所大学美术系大三的学生。我写信是想提出一个关 于改善我们图书馆服务的建议。 In the first place, the librarians especially MsLiu and Mr Zhang are always impatient as well as uncourteous whenever students ask them for help. What's more, it is beyond dispute that the books available in the library are so old that they fail to catch up with the latest development of related disciplines. In the end, more English books and magazines such as Nature, New York times could be added, which could broaden the horizon of students on campus. 译文：首先，图书管理员，尤其是刘老师和张老师，每当学生向他们求助时，他们总 是很不耐烦，也很不礼貌。更重要的是，无可争议的是，图书馆里的书太旧了，以至 于跟不上相关学科的最新发展。最后，可以增加更多的英语书籍和杂志，如《自然》、 《纽约时报》，这可以拓宽学生的视野。 At last, thank you for your consideration of my suggestion. I'm looking forward to your reply. 译文：最后，感谢您考虑我的建议。我期待你的回复。 Your sincerely, Li Ming 刘晓艳四级作文模板（报告作文） 参考范文 On June 18, Sunday, a volunteer activity in the local Nursing House was organized by the Student Union which proves to be a success. (时间+地点+活动内容+说他举办很成功) 6 月18 日，星期天，学生会组织了一场在当地养老院的志愿者活动，这次活动取得了 成功。 The activity was aimed at encouraging students to visit the elderly at the Nursing House and help elderly people deal with their troubles in their life. Many students volunteered to participate in this good deed and were engaged in helping the elderly here out by making their meals, washing their clothes and chatting with them. When asked about those volunteers’ feelings about such an experience, all of them responded with a smile, saying“what a wonderful experience and I really appreciate this activity because it makes me learn to care about those who are in need.”（活动目的+活动具体内容） 该活动旨在鼓励学生去敬老院看望老人，帮助老人处理生活中的烦恼。许多学生自愿 参加了这一善举，并通过做饭，洗衣服和与他们聊天来帮助这里的老人。当被问及志 愿者们对这次经历的感受时，他们都笑着说：“这是一次多么美妙的经历，我真的很感 激这次活动，因为它让我学会了关心那些需要帮助的人。” To sum up, the activity is quite successful not only for the elderly but for those students involved.（总结） 总而言之，这次活动不仅对老年人来说很成功，对参与活动的学生来说也很成功。 活动目的

what’s more,..... 首先.,其次..,最重要的是... 引出原因的总起句还可使用以下其一句子 1 The majority of people would agree that 主题has its deep roots. 大多数人会同意，..有其深厚的根源。 2 It is superficially a simple phenomenon, but when subjected to analysis, it has its fundamental reasons. 这表面上是一种简单的现象，但当接受分析时，它有其根本原因。 3 As we know, recognizing a problem is the first step in finding a solution. 正如我们所知，识别问题是找到解决方案的第一步。 4 There exist numerous elements being responsible for the issue 存在许多因素对这个问题负责。 5 The reason for this is not far to seek. 原因并不遥远。 6 It is quite a few factors that can account for my perspective. 有相当多的因素可以解释我的观点 第三段：总结措施段（总结句+1-2 句措施+喊口号（措施有2 句的话，口号可不写）） 第一句:总结句 In short, it is a sound conclusion that can be drawn that... 总之,我们可以得出结论..... 第二句：措施句（我们/政府/家长/学校） 举例:Students, from their early age, could be educated to learn the advantages and disadvantages of living in big cities. 学生们在很小的时候就应该被教育了解生活在大城市的利弊. 结尾句(喊口号）推荐 总结句可三选一。 1 As a result,just as a coin has two sides,主题词is no exception.(正反两面的作文） 因此，就像硬币有两面一样，.......也不例外 2 From what has been mentioned above,we can safely draw the conclusion that..... 通过以上所述，我们可以得出结论..... 3 It is important for us to keep an eye on the subject. 对我们来说，关注这个问题是非常重要的 1 So under no account could 人divert attention from the issue of sth. 因此，无论如何人们都不能把注意力从……问题上转移开。 2 Only by taking these action can people have a more brilliant and glorious future. 只有采取这些行动，人们才能有一个更加灿烂辉煌的未来。 3 The more quickly measures are taken,the more effectively this problem will be solved . 采取的措施越快，这个问题就越能得到有效解决。 称呼 文中给出：Dear+称呼 文中未给出：Dear sir or Madam 正文： 第一段：对于不熟悉的人：自我介绍+写作目的(2 句话） 自我介绍： I am a freshman from the department of +你的专业in this university. 译文：我是这所大学...专业大一的学生 写作目的: The aim of my letter is to +目的 译文：我这封信的目的是..... 对于熟悉的人：问候+写作目的（2 句话） How are you getting on with you life and work/study? The aim of my letter is to +目的 你的生活和工作/学习近来如何？我写这封信的目的是..... 第二段：根据文章要求写 第三段：表示感谢/祝福语+期待回信 At last, thank you for your consideration of my suggestion. I am looking forward to your reply. Yours truly, LiMing 表示感谢 Words fail me when I desire to express my sincere gratitude to you for your kind consideration my requirement/application/complaint 对于您对我的要求/申请/投诉的认真考虑，我无法用语言表达我诚挚的谢意 期待回信： I look forward to a favorable reply at your earliest convenience. 我期待着你能尽快给我一个有利的答复。 刘晓艳四级作文模板（书信作文） 例文： Directions: Suppose you are writing a proposal to your school library about improving it's services, you are writing about its current problems and solutions. 假设你正在写一份关于改善学校图书馆服务的建议，你要写的是它目前存在的问题和 解决方案。 Dear Sir or Madam, I am a junior from the department of Fine Arts in this university. I'm writing to make a proposal about improving the service of our library. 译文：尊敬的先生或女士，我是这所大学美术系大三的学生。我写信是想提出一个关 于改善我们图书馆服务的建议。 In the first place, the librarians especially MsLiu and Mr Zhang are always impatient as well as uncourteous whenever students ask them for help. What's more, it is beyond dispute that the books available in the library are so old that they fail to catch up with the latest development of related disciplines. In the end, more English books and magazines such as Nature, New York times could be added, which could broaden the horizon of students on campus. 译文：首先，图书管理员，尤其是刘老师和张老师，每当学生向他们求助时，他们总 是很不耐烦，也很不礼貌。更重要的是，无可争议的是，图书馆里的书太旧了，以至 于跟不上相关学科的最新发展。最后，可以增加更多的英语书籍和杂志，如《自然》、 《纽约时报》，这可以拓宽学生的视野。 At last, thank you for your consideration of my suggestion. I'm looking forward to your reply. 译文：最后，感谢您考虑我的建议。我期待你的回复。 Your sincerely, Li Ming 刘晓艳四级作文模板（报告作文） 参考范文 On June 18, Sunday, a volunteer activity in the local Nursing House was organized by the Student Union which proves to be a success. (时间+地点+活动内容+说他举办很成功) 6 月18 日，星期天，学生会组织了一场在当地养老院的志愿者活动，这次活动取得了 成功。 The activity was aimed at encouraging students to visit the elderly at the Nursing House and help elderly people deal with their troubles in their life. Many students volunteered to participate in this good deed and were engaged in helping the elderly here out by making their meals, washing their clothes and chatting with them. When asked about those volunteers’ feelings about such an experience, all of them responded with a smile, saying“what a wonderful experience and I really appreciate this activity because it makes me learn to care about those who are in need.”（活动目的+活动具体内容） 该活动旨在鼓励学生去敬老院看望老人，帮助老人处理生活中的烦恼。许多学生自愿 参加了这一善举，并通过做饭，洗衣服和与他们聊天来帮助这里的老人。当被问及志 愿者们对这次经历的感受时，他们都笑着说：“这是一次多么美妙的经历，我真的很感 激这次活动，因为它让我学会了关心那些需要帮助的人。” To sum up, the activity is quite successful not only for the elderly but for those students involved.（总结） 总而言之，这次活动不仅对老年人来说很成功，对参与活动的学生来说也很成功。 活动目的
